title: Noise cancelling, tested at the hardest level: a Korean family dinner
caption:
Noise cancelling, tested at the hardest level: a Korean family dinner.

A spec ad for GOYO, an earbud brand that doesn't exist. Every person at this table is an AI model; nothing was filmed on set. Each relative was directed beat by beat: when the aunt leans in, when a cousin taps his chest, when Grandma reaches over.

Which question would you cancel first?

SYNK PULSE directs AI models to act, for ads and brand films.
